memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord." - Exodus 23:17 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God calls His people to regularly come and appear before Him. Three times a year they were to leave their fields and homes and gather in His presence. Life was busy, the journey took effort, and the work always beckoned — yet God asked them to set it all aside and come. He wanted His people to prioritise being with Him above the endless demands of ordinary life.

There is a gentle challenge in this for us. It is so easy to let the urgent crowd out the eternal, to be so consumed with work, family, and daily pressures that we neglect the simple act of coming before God. But our God desires our presence. He calls us away from the noise to be with Him, not because He needs it, but because we do. Time in His presence is where our souls are refreshed and realigned.

Under the new covenant, we are not limited to three appointed times a year. Through Christ, we have constant access to God, invited to draw near with confidence at any moment (Heb 4:16). What was once a rare and costly journey is now an open door that never closes. Yet the invitation is still to actually come — to make time, to show up, to be present with the God who delights in us. Will you come before Him today?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do I prioritise regular time in God's presence, or let busyness crowd it out?
How can I make the most of the constant access I have to God through Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that through Christ I can come before You any time. Help me not to let busyness crowd You out, but to regularly draw near and be refreshed in Your presence. Amen.
